items.comment: First sentence stands alone and is accurate: the method summons the implicit `ClassTag[T]` and returns it unchanged. The @tparam wording ('erased class the summoned tag describes') matches the terminology used in ClassTag.scala's own doc ('stores the erased class of a given type T'), so it's consistent and correct. @param accurately describes ctag as returned unchanged. Per the @return-drop rule, omitting @return is correct since the first sentence already begins with 'Returns' and fully states what's returned. Tag continuations are lowercase with no trailing period, matching the style of the adjacent `accessible` method's doc in the same file.
